name: Amazon US home mold test kit category data
description: Point-in-time Amazon US category snapshot behind the Ryndix home mold test kit review: conflicting keyword fields, competitor concentration, demand trend and the goods cost the shelf price can support.
measurementTechnique: Live Amazon US category snapshot (top-listing sales, keyword demand, cost per click, review distribution) combined with labelled cost estimates; estimates are identified on the page.

Competing listings under a near-synonym ("home mold test")

headlineVerdict: Home mold test kit, Amazon US: the tool reported 168,228 searches against 139 listings, but a near-synonym reports 17,797 competitors — three orders of magnitude apart, so the field cannot carry a decision. Working backwards from the $22.99–$28.99 shelf, the goods cost that would let paid traffic break even is negative (minus $6.54 at $28.99). Verdict: stop.

unitEconomics.description: Canonical unit-economics fields for cross-category comparison. A null value means the review never recorded that measurement; see notMeasured. Values are reused from variableMeasured, not recomputed.
